result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): B uses an explicit 4px spacing scale (4/8/12/16/24/32) the whole way through. It also sets the filters apart as a tinted, borderless bar, unlike the bordered schedule card, and leaves larger gaps between sections than inside them. A is tidy, with consistent 12px insets, but its spacing values are ad hoc (14, 10, 9, 3px) and the filters, schedule and summary all share one bordered panel style, so the regions are less distinct. B's flaws are small: the room filter has no 'All rooms' option and the Room field in the summary is hard-coded. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): A uses a stated 4px spacing scale (4/8/12/16/24/32) throughout, and its larger gaps between regions than within them keep the dense areas readable. Its tinted, borderless filter bar stands out clearly from the white bordered schedule, and its 48px rows with 8/16px padding are easy to scan. B adds useful extras (column headers, dark mode, a consistent 12px inset), but its spacing values are ad hoc (3, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10, 14), its filter panel looks the same as the schedule panel, and its 44px rows with zero vertical padding are tight for two lines of text.
